headline: Names the Oxford, Mississippi post office building at 401 McElroy Drive after Army First Lieutenant Donald C. Carwile.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building in Oxford, Mississippi, as the Army First Lieutenant Donald C. Carwile Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016.
